message.jaymoskingdoms.rider.starter: A horse of your own: this %s is yours, saddled and already fond of you. It's no racer: barely faster than you at a full run, until it masters racing. Better horses are out there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.race.start: Off you go! The finish post is %s blocks away at %s, %s: look for the column of light.
message.jaymoskingdoms.race.lost: Too slow: the race is lost.
message.jaymoskingdoms.race.finish.0: Gold! Over the line in %s. Your prize: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.race.finish.1: Silver: over the line in %s. Your prize: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.race.mount: You race on your own horse: get in the saddle first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.race.no_course: There's no open ground for a course from here. Your entry is back.
